deaths.better: Back off into the river immediately once Alistar falls rather than tanking minion and tower pressure.
deaths.whatHappened: At 7:03, you and Xayah overstayed under the bot lane tower after killing Alistar, allowing Caitlyn to clean you both up.

deaths.better: This death was fine because your crowd control locked down three enemies and led directly to your team taking Baron.
deaths.whatHappened: At 20:37, you engaged into Zac and Alistar with your charm and knockup before Riven flanked in and bursted you down.

deaths.better: Once Karthus was doomed, use Battle Dance backward over the wall to disengage safely.
deaths.whatHappened: At 22:01, you dove into a jungle bottleneck to peel for Karthus, but he died and you were trapped without cooldowns.

deaths.better: This death was good play because your disruption let Karthus and Xayah instantly sweep the teamfight.
deaths.whatHappened: At 23:56, you started an objective fight by diving into Zac and Caitlyn, absorbing all their initial cooldowns before Caitlyn took you down.

coach.headline: You set up huge teamfights and kept your carries fed with 36 assists to secure a convincing win.
coach.nextGame: Keep tabs on flankers like Riven before committing your full dive combo into tight terrain.
